Parent-child chunking, GPU support, file lock, skip code files, Italian paths

Initial release of local-rag: semantic search for local files.

- Enables semantic search across local PDFs, DOCX, TXT, MD, and common code/text files.
- Uses BGE-M3 embeddings and BGE-RERANKER-LARGE reranker for accurate retrieval.
- Employs parent-child chunking: searches small chunks, returns larger context chunks.
- Persistent local vector database (ChromaDB); CLI tools provided for indexing and searching.
- Supports natural language queries and custom file path indexing.
